gui.guhs.sterren.gevangen: Caught! A little star full of dream sand, vahoeg!
gui.guhs.sterren.weg: Njeg... that little star already faded.
gui.guhs.sterren.grote_ster.sub: A wish: a little place of his own.
gui.guhs.sterren.grote_ster.chat: You catch the big falling star. It whispers a wish: 'a little place of my own to sleep'. That is a piece of Snoes's dream!
gui.guhs.sterren.grote_ster.al: The star twinkles at you. You already have Snoes's wish, vads!
block.guhs.stuiterkussen_boter.lore: Boing! Jump on it and you bounce high into the air. Sneak to just stand on it.
